summary: Tested festival calendar on Home, the /festivals screen, and POI ticket prices on the API and place detail screen. Almost everything works. Found 1 functional bug: the 'Usa questa data' button selects the wrong day for festivals that last several days.

minor.issue: Only fills fields that are empty. If a POI already has an old wrong price/hours in the DB (for example on another environment or in production), the corrected price is never applied. That works here because the fields were empty, but it is a risk for the 'fix ticket prices' request.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses festPopup[0].start (the festival's start date) instead of the day that was tapped. Tapping 3 Jan 2027 (only the Presepe Vivente, 25 Dec–6 Jan) and pressing 'Usa questa data' selects 25 Dec 2026, not 3 Jan. The same happens with Trappeto Assunta (8–16 Aug), Cous Cous Fest and others. Fix: store the tapped dateString with the popup and pass it to selectDay.

issues: The 'Usa questa data' button label wraps onto 3 lines at 390px width; shorten it or stack the buttons
The hero image is broken: a placeholder icon shows instead of a photo

verified_ok: Nov 2026 dots: 1,2,6,7,8,12,14,15,21,22,25. 26 Nov has no dot, and that is correct: no rule falls on 26 Nov (the review request's expectation was wrong)
Dec 2026 popups: 8 Immacolata; 13 Santa Lucia; 25 Natale + Presepe; 26 Santo Stefano + Campofiorito + Presepe; 31 San Silvestro + Presepe

Mar 2027: 19 has 8 entries (San Giuseppe in 7 comuni + Salemi Pani e Cene), the popup scrolls and its buttons are reachable; 25 Trappeto Annunziata + Marsala Giovedì Santo; 26–27 Misteri Trapani; 28 Pasqua (+ 3 local rites)
National holidays show 'Tutta Italia' with no '(IT)', and regional ones show no '(SIC)'
/festivals: intro says '157 ricorrenze'; filter counts: all 157, PA 103, TP 38, sagra 10, nazionale 16; approximate items show '(indicativo)' and the warning note

Gangi ea(50) = 17 May 2027 and Valderice wd(11,20,0) = 21 Nov 2027 are correct in the code, but they are not shown on the list because they fall outside the 12-month window (the list does show Valderice 22 Nov 2026)
Prices from the API and on the place pages: Teatro Massimo €14 with hours, Segesta €14 (ridotto €7), Selinunte €17; the Tickets button is present
action_items: Make fest-popup-select use the tapped date instead of festPopup[0].start
Consider overwriting the old ticket prices for the listed POIs (or a one-time migration) instead of filling only empty fields
Fix the broken Selinunte image; shorten the popup button label
critical_code_review_comments: In the guest index.tsx the festival popup closes when the backdrop is pressed; that works. Festival days that are blocked (booked) cannot be tapped, so their popup never opens. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar day testIDs: availability-calendar.day_YYYY-MM-DD; arrows: availability-calendar.header.rightArrow. The browser date is 2026-11-05. POI ids: Teatro Massimo 30ade5bf..., Segesta b43b6a9d..., Selinunte 453309d8....
